subject: Status: DiscoFuse repro done, insertion drift on long rewrites
body:
Status.

DiscoFuse repro is done end-to-end: label-map construction with pointing enabled, data conversion, and fine-tuning both models off the BERT checkpoints — our exact-match numbers land within half a point of the paper's reported fusion results, so the pipeline is faithful.

Internal rewrite corpus: tagging transfers well — the keep/delete/reorder decisions look sensible almost immediately — but the insertion model is the weak link. On longer rewrites it in-fills fluent text that drifts from the source meaning, which is exactly what the meaning-preservation scale in Maren's rating tool should catch. The tool itself is on track for Mar 31; Fumiko has the rating protocol drafted.

Risk: if human ratings confirm the drift at scale, we'll need a constrained-insertion variant, which doesn't fit before May 8 — flagging now so the pre-read can frame it honestly.

Tereza
